brief:
## Affected callers

- `IAnalyzer::semantic_diagnostics` now returns a report (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:620). The LSP caller consumes its iterator only after parse diagnostics are empty and semantic diagnostics are enabled (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/handlers/diagnostic.rs:97).
- The new Java realm lookup calls `resolve_type_name_with` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:213). Forward source lookup also calls that resolver (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/imports.rs:222). Its existing tiers select explicit imports, wildcard imports, then the current package (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/imports.rs:303, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/imports.rs:321, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/imports.rs:345).
- Kotlin's report wrapper consumes the existing collector (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/mod.rs:435). That collector returns an empty vector for sources above its byte limit or sources with parse errors (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/diagnostics.rs:71).
- The retained overlay now shares publication state with dependency evidence (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:893). Workspace symbol search reads this overlay and adds modeled symbols after filtering names already supplied by workspace declarations (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/handlers/workspace_symbol.rs:48).
- The existing `acquire_active_semantic_models` entry point now forwards without discovery evidence (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:1393). MCP activation still calls that entry point (crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:275). Policy evaluation also calls it and maps non-ready outcomes to activation error text (crates/bifrost-policy/src/coordinator.rs:935).
- Python activation now delegates to the shared ecosystem lifecycle (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:436). LSP workspace construction calls this wrapper with its configured environment and logs an incomplete outcome (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:3497).

## Paths

- Java diagnostic collection calls `external_boundary_evidence` when workspace lookup returns no candidates (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/diagnostics.rs:71). That method initializes the Java external index through `get_or_init` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:247, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:263). Index construction runs JVM dependency discovery with default limits and no cancellation token (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/jvm/external.rs:969).
- Both cached and newly resolved activation paths publish persistent state before building the overlay (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:1454, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:1480). Persistent publication calls `replace_workspace_active_set` when persistence is supplied (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:1555). Overlay cancellation returns `Cancelled`; a retained-byte limit returns `Unavailable` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:1513).
- The watched-file handler updates the workspace before refreshing remembered diagnostic documents (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:1942). `WorkspaceAnalyzer::update` delegates to `MultiAnalyzer` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:816). Relevant delegate changes create fresh caches; an update with no relevant changes retains the existing caches (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:690).
- The new watched-file refresh calls the same publisher as a runtime diagnostic-setting change (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:1947, crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:2058). The publisher sends a notification even for an empty diagnostic list (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:1992).

## Value flow

- Java's new realm lookup obtains candidates from `global_usage_definition_index` and filters for exact, non-synthetic class declarations (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:215). `MultiAnalyzer` supplies that index by merging the definition shards from every delegate (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:779).
- Java's external outcome uses a boundary and optional name from the existing external resolver (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/diagnostics.rs:71). The producer returns `ExternalIndexed` for a resolved external type, `ExternalDeclaredUnindexed` when production diagnostics exist, and `ExternalUnknown` otherwise (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:248). The collector separately reads overlay presence through the snapshot cache accessor (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/java/diagnostics.rs:81, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:869).
- The new discovery-to-diagnostic conversion reads `truncated()` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/dependency.rs:436). `DependencyDiscoveryEvidence::from_outcome` assigns this field from `!outcome.complete` and collects module identities from package coordinates, module coordinates, and artifact modules (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/dependency.rs:374).
- The workspace lifecycle clones the caller's activation request into its local `activation` value (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:273). The Go overlay fixture builds a request with module `fixture.invalid` evidence and workspace enable controls for the registered `fixture.go.reader` and `fixture.go.consumer` session packs (tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:337, tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:348), passes it to `acquire_active_semantic_models`, and receives `Ready` (tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:377).
- Shared activation passes per-ecosystem configuration and the workspace project to dependency resolvers (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:288). The LSP caller builds `AnalyzerConfig` from its Python environment plus default values for other fields (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/server.rs:3460).
- Workspace absence conversion stores `file.rel_path()` in the proof domain (crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/model.rs:2786). Existing `ProjectFile` path handling supplies that workspace-relative path through its accessor (crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/model.rs:1776).
- Report iteration yields only diagnostic items (crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/model.rs:2867). The LSP converter maps each item's byte range, kind, source, and message to an error-severity diagnostic with `data: None` (crates/bifrost-lsp/src/lsp/handlers/diagnostic.rs:137).
rationale: Reworded the Go fixture item to a plain description of the request it builds and the entry point it calls, dropping the 'without dependency discovery' clause; anchors and the stated relation are unchanged.
